title: REQ · BootScene.create plays the authored transition on scene start
summary: BootScene calls the engine helper with the Phaser effect context and the bundled scene
description: Context: BootScene.create builds effects via buildEffects(createPhaserEffectContext(this), scene) but never plays the transition. Desired behavior: create() builds the context once and also calls playSceneTransition with the same context and scene. Expected result: a fade plays when the scene starts. Why: the visible fade transition is part of the goal.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create runs with a scene that has a fade entry, when the context playTransition is observed, then it is called once with the content durationMs
Given BootScene.create runs with a scene lacking a transition, then playTransition is not called
